text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Special Week. A powerhouse renowned for 
her tremendous closing burst.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her tandem training was a sight to behold. 
Many other Trainers and Umamusume had 
gathered to watch, alongside myself――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
As expected, that acceleration is 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing overlapping voices, I turned to 
look and locked eyes with the Umamusume 
standing beside me. If I recall, she's a 
student named Buena Vistaâ

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hehe, we said that in unison, didn't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san's final stretch kick is so cool. 
No matter how many times I watch it... my 
heart trembles.
choice_data_list: Do you look up to her?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —! Yes, understood.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I... I was inspired by Spe-san, and that's 
what made me want to join the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san's running is powerful, yet so 
warm. Beyond running with all her 
heart――lies a truly magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I was just so captivated by the sight... I 
guess. It made me want to run like that 
too――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, her expression was lively 
and full of joy.
choice_data_list:
Since you have the chance, why not go run 
together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, her expression was lively 
and full of joy.
choice_data_list:
Since you have the chance, why not go run 
together?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Every time I see it, I can't help but 
admire it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day, seeing the heights 
Spe-san reached, I've wanted to get there 
myself, more and more fiercely...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I want to be the one showing 
others. I want to move people's hearts 
with my own legs.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, I was just trying to look cool.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Buena Vista spoke of her admiration for 
Special Week, her eyes sparkled brightly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Special Week run, she looked 
almost restless, as if itching to jump in 
herself.
choice_data_list:
Makes you want to go for a run, doesn't 
it?

Makes you want to go for a run, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ――Ehehe. Was it written all over my 
face?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Well then, maybe I'll ask for some help... 
Alright, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Spe-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched over Buena Vista for a while as 
she dashed up and started talking 
excitedly with Special Week.
